messages.subject: Legend Order
parts:
What is the best way to adjust the legend so that it matches the order
in which factors are plotted?

Example output can be found here (http://ggplot2.googlegroups.com/web/
Ex_Legend.jpg). The legend order is not the same as the plotting
order. I imagined this has to have been asked before but could not dig
up any relavent info in my search.

Thanks in advance for any help!

messages.author: 599a13812d4cd3e8
messages.subject: Re: Legend Order
parts:
Is the ordering you want fixed, or do you want to order it according to something like the average value of the time-series?

In general the order in the legend follows the order of the levels in the factor. Try something like

data$condition <- as.factor(data$condition, levels=c("4.5mg","6.0mg ACN",...) #... meaning so on for the order you want the Legend.

But it would be easier to help if you provided a complete (ie runnable), minimal example....
